statement: Every application read surface is inventoried and routes through an approved DataFn client or adapter.
scope: Every page loader, component query, server route, scheduled job, export and background read.
prohibitedBypasses: Direct database queries outside approved adapters

rules.pass: All relevant surfaces are inventoried, reconciled to source paths and evidenced at the exact commit. Required static, runtime and test evidence independently confirms approved routing.
rules.fail: Any relevant surface uses a prohibited bypass or authorization or tenant-isolation tests fail.
rules.unknown: Any surface is unaccounted for, any required evidence is missing, or the verifier cannot independently establish routing.
